links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT Spanish patient information (Flesch/Szigriszt scores)
links.effect: Responses were 'moderately difficult' (median 54.73, IQR 51.59-58.58); heart failure lowest (median 50.6, IQR 46.3-53.8).
links.quote: In readability, responses were "moderately difficult" (54.73, interquartile range (IQR) 51.59-58.58), with better results for CKD (median 56.1, IQR 53.5-59.1) and RA (56.4, IQR 53.7-60.7), than for heart failure responses (median 50.6, IQR 46.3-53.8).

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of ChatGPT Spanish responses to patient questions
links.effect: Responses were 'moderately difficult' to read (median 54.73); authors conclude readability needs to improve before recommending as a patient tool.
links.quote: Our study suggests that the ChatGPT tool can be a reliable source of information in spanish for patients with chronic diseases with different reliability for some of them, however, it needs to improve the readability of its answers to be recommended as a useful tool for patients.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the reliability and readability of ChatGPT responses to frequently asked patient questions regarding chronic diseases in Spanish.
